H0840.name: Asarel
H0840.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0840.brief: Son of Jehallelel, from the tribe of Judah
H0840.short: Asarel was a son of Jehallelel, a descendant of Judah (<ref="1Ch.4.16">1Ch.4.16</ref>).

H0841.name: Asharelah
H0841.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0841.brief: Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres
H0841.short: Asharelah (or Jesharelah) was a Levite musician appointed by David to prophesy with lyres (<ref="1Ch.25.2, 14">1Ch.25.2, 14</ref>).

H0836.name: Asher
H0836.desc: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0836.brief: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher
H0836.short: Asher was the eighth son of Jacob, born to Zilpah, Leah's maidservant, and became the founder of the tribe of Asher (<ref="Gen.30.13; 46:17; Deu.33:24; Jos.19:24-34; Luke 2.36">Gen.30.13; 46:17; Deu.33:24; Jos.19:24-34; Luke 2.36</ref>).

H0806.name: Ashhur
H0806.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0806.short: Ashhur, a descendant of Judah through Hezron, was the  father (ie founder) of Tekoa (<ref="1Ch.2.24; 4:5">1Ch.2.24; 4:5</ref>).

H0813G.name: Ashkenaz
H0813G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0813G.brief: Grandson of Japheth, son of Gomer
H0813G.short: Ashkenaz was a grandson of Japheth and son of Gomer, mentioned in the Table of Nations (<ref="Gen.10.3; 1Ch.1.6">Gen.10.3; 1Ch.1.6</ref>).
H0813G.meaning: “a man as sprinkled: fire as scattered”

forms.meaning: “a man as sprinkled: fire as scattered”

H0828.name: Ashpenaz
H0828.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0828.short: Ashpenaz was the chief official in Nebuchadnezzar's court, responsible for selecting and training young Israelite exiles (<ref="Dan.1.3">Dan.1.3</ref>).

H0844H.name: Asriel
H0844H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0844H.brief: Son of Gilead, descendant of Manasseh
H0844H.short: Asriel was a son of Gilead and a descendant of Manasseh (<ref="1Ch.7.14">1Ch.7.14</ref>).

H0844G.name: Asriel
H0844G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0844G.brief: Son of Manasseh, founder of the Asrielite clan
H0844G.short: Asriel was a son of Manasseh and the founder of the Asrielite clan (<ref="Num.26.31; Josh 17:2">Num.26.31; Josh 17:2</ref>).

H0804H.name: Asshur
H0804H.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0804H.brief: Son of Shem; father of the Assyrians
H0804H.short: Asshur was a son of Shem and is considered the father of the Assyrians (<ref="Gen.10.22; 1Ch.1.17">Gen.10.22; 1Ch.1.17</ref>).

H0805A.name: Asshurim
H0805A.short: Asshurim was a descendant of Abraham through his son Jokshan and grandson Dedan (<ref="Gen.25.3">Gen.25.3</ref>).

H0893G.name: Bebai
H0893G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0893G.brief: Head of a family that returned from Babylonian exile.
H0893G.short: Bebai was the head of a family that returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H0893H.name: Bebai
H0893H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0893H.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned with Ezra to Jerusalem.
H0893H.short: Zechariah, a descendant of Bebai, led 28 men of his family to return with Ezra to Jerusalem.

H0893I.name: Bebai
H0893I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0893I.brief: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
H0893I.short: Bebai was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H0878.name: Beera
H0878.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0878.brief: A descendant of Asher through Zophah.
H0878.short: Beera was a descendant of Asher, listed in the genealogy of Zophah.

H0880.name: Beerah
H0880.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0880.brief: A Reubenite leader exiled by the Assyrian king Tiglath-Pileser.
H0880.short: Beerah, a leader from the tribe of Reuben, was taken into exile by Tiglath-Pileser, king of Assyria.

H0882G.name: Beeri
H0882G.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0882G.brief: A Hittite, father of Esau's wife Judith.
H0882G.short: Beeri the Hittite was the father of Judith, one of Esau's wives.

H0882H.name: Beeri
H0882H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0882H.short: Beeri was the father of Hosea, the prophet who authored the biblical book bearing his name.

H0812G.name: Eshcol
H0812G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0812G.brief: Amorite ally of Abram; valley named after him.
H0812G.short: Eshcol was an Amorite, an ally of Abram, and the valley of Eshcol was named after him.

H0850.name: Eshton
H0850.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0850.brief: Son of Mehir; father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah.
H0850.short: Eshton was the son of Mehir and the father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah.

H0856.name: Ethbaal
H0856.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0856.brief: King of Sidon; father of Jezebel.
H0856.short: Ethbaal was the king of Sidon and the father of Jezebel, who married King Ahab of Israel.

H0869.name: Ethnan
H0869.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0869.brief: Son of Ashhur, the founder of Tekoa.
H0869.short: Ethnan was a son of Ashhur (or 'Ashur'), the  father (ie founder) of Tekoa.

H0863G.name: Ittai
H0863G.desc: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
H0863G.brief: Gittite commander who remained loyal to David.
H0863G.short: Ittai the Gittite was a commander who remained loyal to David during Absalom's rebellion.

H0863H.name: Ittai
H0863H.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H0863H.short: Ittai, one of King David's mighty men, was from Gibeah of Benjamin.

H0831.name: Ashkelon
H0831.brief: A major Philistine city, often a target of prophecy.
H0831.short: Ashkelon, one of the five principal Philistine cities, was captured by Judah but later became a symbol of judgment.

H0813H.name: Ashkenaz
H0813H.brief: A kingdom summoned to battle against Babylon.
H0813H.short: Ashkenaz, a kingdom called to join the fight against Babylon in Jeremiah's prophecy.
H0813H.meaning: “a man as sprinkled: fire as scattered”

forms.meaning: “a man as sprinkled: fire as scattered”

H0823.name: Ashnah
H0823.brief: Two cities in the Shephelah region of Judah.
H0823.short: Ashnah, two cities in the lowlands of Judah, mentioned in the tribal allotment.

H0804G.name: Assyria
H0804G.brief: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.
H0804G.short: Assyria, a major Mesopotamian empire, frequently mentioned in the Old Testament as an adversary of Israel and Judah.

H0871.name: Atharim
H0871.brief: A place where the Canaanite king of Arad fought Israel.
H0871.short: Atharim, a place near the Negev where the Canaanite king of Arad attacked the Israelites during their journey.

H0894.name: Babylon
H0894.brief: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.
H0894.short: Babylon, also known as Babel, Sheshak, Merathaim, or Pekod, was an ancient Mesopotamian city that served as the capital of the Babylonian Empire. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H0876G.name: Beer
H0876G.brief: Site where God provided water for the Israelites.
H0876G.short: Beer was a site where God provided water for the Israelites during their wilderness journey. (<ref="Numbers 21:16">Numbers 21:16</ref>)

H0879.name: Beer-elim
H0879.brief: Place mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy against Moab.
H0879.short: Beer-elim was a place mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy against Moab. (<ref="Isaiah 15:8">Isaiah 15:8</ref>)

H0883.name: Beer-lahai-roi
H0883.brief: Well where Hagar encountered the Angel of the Lord.
H0883.short: Beer-lahai-roi was a well where Hagar encountered the Angel of the Lord, between Kadesh and Bered.
H0883.meaning: “well of the Living One seeing me”

forms.meaning: “well of the Living One seeing me”

H0881G.name: Beeroth
H0881G.brief: Hivite city, later allotted to Benjamin.
H0881G.short: Beeroth (or Beer) was a Hivite city that later became part of the territory allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.

H0884.name: Beersheba
H0884.brief: Important city in southern Israel, associated with the patriarchs.
H0884.short: Beersheba (Sheba or Shibah) was an important city in southern Israel, associated with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. (Multiple references, see article for details)

H0830G.name: Dung Gate
H0830G.brief: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, possibly used for waste removal.
H0830G.short: The Dung Gate was one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, possibly used for removing waste from the city (<ref="Nehemiah 2:13; 3:13-14; 12:31">Nehemiah 2:13; 3:13-14; 12:31</ref>).

H0824.name: Eshan
H0824.brief: City in the hill country of Judah
H0824.short: Eshan, a city in the hill country of Judah, allotted to the tribe of Judah.

H0812H.name: Eshcol Valley
H0812H.brief: Valley where Israelite spies obtained a large cluster of grapes
H0812H.short: The Eshcol Valley, where the Israelite spies cut down a large cluster of grapes during their reconnaissance mission in Canaan.

H0847.name: Eshtaol
H0847.brief: City allotted to Judah and Dan; associated with Samson
H0847.short: Eshtaol, a city allotted to Judah and Dan, was the hometown of Samson and the starting point of the Danite migration.

H0851.name: Eshtemoa
H0851.brief: Levitical city in Judah; received spoils from David's victory
H0851.short: Eshtemoa (or Eshtemoh), a Levitical city in Judah, was the home of several individuals and received spoils from David's victory over the Amalekites.
H0851.meaning: “I will make myself heard” Eshtemoh = “I shall cause my own ruin: fire of astonishment: I shall soar aloft”

forms.meaning: “I will make myself heard” Eshtemoh = “I shall cause my own ruin: fire of astonishment: I shall soar aloft”
“I will make myself heard” Eshtemoh = “I shall cause my own ruin: fire of astonishment: I shall soar aloft”

H0864.name: Etham
H0864.brief: Wilderness area where Israelites camped during the Exodus
H0864.short: Etham, a wilderness area on the edge of the desert where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to the Promised Land.

H0842.name: Asherah
H0842.brief: Canaanite goddess; associated with wooden poles, idolatry
H0842.short: Asherah, a Canaanite goddess, was worshipped by the Israelites through wooden poles or images, often leading them into idolatry.

H0807.name: Ashima
H0807.brief: Deity worshipped by the people of Hamath
H0807.short: Ashima was a deity worshipped by the people of Hamath who were resettled in Samaria by the Assyrian king (<ref="2Ki.17.30">2Ki.17.30</ref>).
